title: Validation baseline for archkeel validate --baseline
$comment: Written by `archkeel validate --baseline <path> --write-baseline` (AD-52, AD-78, AD-89, AD-90). A fingerprint is the rules a violation breaks and the sorted subjects they name; roles are protected directional evidence without changing identity. Budgets are accepted values for contract-selected deterministic measurements.

schema_version.description: Current writer schema; the reader also accepts baseline schemas 1.0.0 and 1.1.0.

budgets.description: Exact accepted values for the measurement_budgets selected by the architecture contract.

violations.description: Every violation the code is known to commit today, one entry per fingerprint. Counts must match the observed code exactly: a higher one is a new violation, a lower one is work already done that has to leave this file.

rules.description: The declared rule ids this violation breaks, as the observation records them.

subjects.description: The sorted names the violation is about: modules, a construct owner or the members of a cycle, by kind. Sorted, so they carry no direction.

count.description: How many violations share this fingerprint, for example two getattr calls in one function.

roles.description: Sorted directional evidence from source_module/target_module. Roles do not change the fingerprint, but role-only drift is protected because validation can use them.
